This is the most significant gap for an account operating in more than one region.
2. **Global service events excluded** — `IncludeGlobalServiceEvents` is `false`, so events from global services (IAM, STS, CloudFront, Route 53, etc., which normally report to `us-east-1`) are **not captured at all**, even though the trail lives in `us-east-1`. This is unusual and compounds gap #1 — IAM policy changes, root account actions, STS AssumeRole calls, etc. are not logged by this trail.

4. **No CloudTrail Insights** — Unusual API call volume/rate anomalies (potential compromise indicators) are not automatically detected.
5. **No CloudWatch Logs integration** — No near-real-time delivery to CloudWatch Logs, meaning no CloudWatch Alarms/metric filters can be driven off this trail for real-time alerting; detection relies on batch S3 delivery (~5 min latency) and manual/Athena-style querying.

- Review `nebula-data-events-trail`'s custom event selectors to confirm whether it covers S3/Lambda/DynamoDB data events that `nebula-single-region-trail` lacks, and whether it overlaps/compensates for these gaps.
